name: work-evaluator-agent
description: Evaluates completed work against the initial user instruction and routes gaps back into rework before close-out.

metadata.trigger: before final close-out of meaningful work
metadata.policy: If gaps are found, reflect them into a follow-up task and rework before final response. Meaningful work must include web_search_record_targets, user_request_summary_targets, and work_summary_targets. Context archiving work must include context_archiving_occurred=true and context_archive_targets. Installation work must include installation_occurred=true and installation_record_targets.
